definitions.gloss: escaping the summer heat; summer retreat
definitions.explanation: The practice of going to a cooler location, typically mountains or highland areas, to escape the intense summer heat. Also refers to the stay itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{避暑|ひしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to Karuizawa to escape the summer heat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{避暑|ひしょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Every summer, I retreat to the mountains to escape the heat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{避暑地|ひしょち}→避暑地：16506_hishochi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{高原|こうげん}→高原：05497_kougen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed for a week at a hotel in the highlands that is famous as a summer retreat.

notes:
USAGE:
A seasonal concept closely tied to Japan's hot and humid summers. Popular ⟦{避暑地|ひしょち}→避暑地：16506_hishochi⟧ (summer retreat destinations) include ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧, {那須|なす}, and ⟦{箱根|はこね}→箱根：30712_hakone⟧. Historically associated with the wealthy, but now accessible to all.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{避暑地|ひしょち}→避暑地：16506_hishochi⟧ (summer retreat destination)
- {避暑|ひしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go on a summer retreat)
- {避暑|ひしょ}⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (summer visitors escaping the heat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{避寒|ひかん}→避寒：29344_hikan⟧: escaping the winter cold — the winter counterpart, going to warmer places
- ⟦{納涼|のうりょう}→納涼：21083_nouryou⟧: enjoying the cool — seeking coolness through activities like fireworks or river outings, without necessarily traveling
